why: a statement's ROUTER, not only its tags — and the lint's own computed answer (beta.364) is one version too low here, for the same reason this floor was beta.355 before. `statements` became a template source in beta.364, which brought 13 pii masks with it: the whole `billing_address` block, `scope.name`, and the organization chain at `organization_path[].name` and `lines[].organization_path[].name`. But `core/src/utils/fixture-pii.ts`'s QUALIFIED_CATEGORY had NO route for `organization_path.name` until beta.365. A build at beta.364 therefore has every tag and still masks a customer's organization name with the wrong CATEGORY of fake — masked, but the wrong kind of fake, which is exactly the api-cloudrun#837 defect the beta.355 floor was raised for and is unverifiable by any oracle afterwards. `lint-capture-floor.ts` compares TAG SETS and cannot see a missing route, so its recommendation is a floor and not a ceiling. Subsumes beta.355's router fix and every pii mask below it. Verified against the deployment before raising: prod serves revision api-cloudrun-00352-h2d from v0.236.0, whose deno.json pins 10.0.0-beta.365, so this floor refuses no capture it was meant to permit.

Raise min_core ONLY to a version api-cloudrun has DEPLOYED, or every capture is refused until it does — read the running pin off `/openapi.json`'s info.version, map it to a release tag, and read that tag's deno.json.
